mechanism: Explicit external force plus its moment about the bottle center of mass, applied at base height. No object teleportation or attachment. Magnitude and true displacement are scoring/setup data and never enter the learned controller.
comparison: Run identical seed and force in live-image and initial-image-frozen modes. At the same measured robot state, record both image-conditioned joint predictions. Preserve all physical failures and any displacement outside the calibrated range.
initial_trial: Exposed training seed 2026095102 only. Development/evaluation seeds stay separate until a controller is selected.
